claim: Implementation Guide for ADR-045: Step-by-step how to harden any orama-system skill using gstack/gbrain/CRG. (1) Identify skills (any that call gbrain/gstack/CRG tools). (2) Add safety library preamble (source bin/orama-system/scripts/lib/gstack-gbrain-crg-safe.sh). (3) Run pre-flight checks (_detect_errors) before first external call. (4) Guard external calls: simple=_retry_with_backoff, state-modifying=_with_lock, queries=timeout+fallback. (5) Add post-operation health checks (_health_check). (6) Use _err_actionable for clear error messages. Priority skills to update: code-review, mcp-install, using-git-worktrees, first-run-setup, orama-gstack. Testing scenarios: happy path, gbrain offline, lock contention, timeout. Checklist in docs/how-to/hardening-gstack-gbrain-skills.md.
conditions: skills gstack gbrain crg hardening implementation pattern
